name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly transferred to bank accounts of landholding farmer families across India.

eligibility.criteria: Farmer families with cultivable landholding in their name. Institutional landholders and high-income taxpayers/professionals are excluded.

benefits: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly into bank accounts in 3 installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months.
documents_required: Bank Account details with IFSC (Aadhaar seeded)
application_steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click on 'New Farmer Registration'.
Enter Aadhaar number and select state.
Fill in land details and bank account information.
Submit and complete e-KYC via OTP or biometrics at CSC.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority
summary: World's largest health assurance scheme providing health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor families, plus universal coverage for all senior citizens aged 70+.

eligibility.criteria: Identified by SECC 2011 database or NFSA ration card holders, OR any Indian citizen aged 70 years and above irrespective of income.

benefits: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empaneled public and private hospitals across India.
application_steps: Visit beneficiary.nha.gov.in or download Ayushman App.
Login with mobile number and verify via Aadhaar OTP.
Search family in SECC/NFSA database.
Complete e-KYC and download Ayushman Card.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: Provides pucca houses or interest subsidy on home loans for eligible urban families belonging to EWS/LIG and Middle-Income segments.

eligibility.criteria: Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Female ownership or co-ownership is mandatory in EWS/LIG.

benefits: Interest subsidy up to ₹1.80 - ₹2.67 lakh on home loans or upfront financial assistance of ₹1.5 lakh for house construction.
documents_required: Aadhaar card of all family members
Affidavit of not owning a pucca house
application_steps: Apply through participating primary lending institutions (banks/HFCs) for CLSS, or via pmaymis.gov.in.
Fill online citizen assessment form with Aadhaar verification.
Submit property and income documents to the bank.
Subsidy is credited directly into your loan account upon verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
summary: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh (plains) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) for construction of pucca house with basic amenities.

eligibility.criteria: Families living in zero, one or two-room kutcha houses as per SECC 2011/Awaas+ survey list.

benefits: ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/NE states directly transferred in stages, plus 90-95 days of MGNREGA wages and ₹12,000 for toilet construction.
application_steps: Beneficiaries are selected by Gram Sabha based on Awaas+ list.
Contact Gram Panchayat Secretary or Block Development Officer (BDO).
Geo-tagged photos of existing site and progress are uploaded via AwaasSoft.
Funds transferred directly via DBT.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: Collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹20 lakh for non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises under Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.

eligibility.criteria: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for non-farm income generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading, or service.

benefits: Loans without collateral: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 lakh). Low interest rates.
documents_required: Business registration / Trade license / Udyam Certificate
Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased
application_steps: Visit udyamimitra.in portal or any public/private commercial bank/NBFC.
Fill the Mudra loan application form with business plan details.
Submit required KYC and business documents.
Loan is disbursed with Mudra debit card for working capital.

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: Affordable micro-credit working capital loan for street vendors, starting with ₹10,000, then ₹20,000, and up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment.

eligibility.criteria: Street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas possessing Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).

benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan: 1st tranche ₹10,000 (1 yr), 2nd tranche ₹20,000 (1.5 yrs), 3rd tranche ₹50,000 (3 yrs). 7% interest subsidy + cashback up to ₹1,200/year on digital transactions.
documents_required: Vending Certificate or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB/Municipality
application_steps: Apply online on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through Common Service Centers (CSC).
Enter Aadhaar and Mobile number for OTP verification.
Verify Vending Certificate or LoR.
Select preferred bank and submit application.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Ministry of Finance
summary: A government-backed small savings scheme under 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' with high interest (8.2% p.a.) and full tax exemption (EEE) under Section 80C.

eligibility.criteria: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child can open an account before she turns 10 years old. Maximum 2 accounts per family.

benefits: High compound interest rate (8.2% p.a. sovereign guarantee). Tax deduction up to ₹1.5 lakh under 80C. Interest earned and maturity amount are 100% tax-free. Account matures after 21 years or upon marriage after 18.
application_steps: Visit any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Fill out the SSY Account Opening Form.
Submit KYC documents along with child's birth certificate.
Deposit minimum opening amount (₹250 minimum, up to ₹1.5 lakh/year).

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
summary: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60 for unorganized sector workers based on monthly contributions starting from ₹42/month.

eligibility.criteria: Any Indian citizen between 18 and 40 years having a savings bank account. Note: Income tax payers are not eligible to join APY.

benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 for life after age 60. Same pension to spouse upon subscriber's death, and full accumulated corpus returned to nominee.
documents_required: Savings Bank Account with Auto-Debit facility
application_steps: Visit bank branch where you have a savings account or apply via NetBanking/Mobile Banking.
Fill APY registration form and choose desired pension amount (₹1,000 - ₹5,000).
Authorize auto-debit of monthly/quarterly contribution.
Receive PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) card.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Comprehensive support for 18 traditional trades: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest.

eligibility.criteria: Artisans engaged in 18 traditional family-based crafts (Carpenter, Boat Maker, Armorer, Blacksmith, Hammer and Tool Kit Maker, Locksmith, Sculptor, Potter, Cobbler, Mason, Basket/Mat/Broom Maker, Doll & Toy Maker, Barber, Garland Maker, Washerman, Tailor, Fishing Net Maker). Limited to one member per family.

benefits: Skill training (5-7 days basic, 15+ days advanced) with ₹500/day stipend; ₹15,000 grant for modern toolkits; collateral-free credit support up to ₹1 lakh (1st tranche) and ₹2 lakh (2nd tranche) at concessional 5% interest; ₹1 per digital transaction incentive.
application_steps: Apply through nearest CSC (Common Service Centre) on pmvishwakarma.gov.in.
Artisan verification done at Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body level.
Upon approval, receive PM Vishwakarma Certificate & Digital ID.
Join training and receive toolkit voucher and loan access.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
target_beneficiaries: Women from BPL / Low Income Families
summary: Provides deposit-free LPG gas connections with first refill and hotplate (stove) free of cost to adult women from poor households, plus ₹300 subsidy per 14.2kg cylinder refill.

eligibility.criteria: Adult woman belonging to poor household without any existing LPG connection in the family.

benefits: Free LPG connection (security deposit waived), free first LPG refill cylinder, free two-burner gas stove, and ongoing subsidy of ₹300 per refill transferred via DBT.
documents_required: Aadhaar card of applicant woman and adult family members
Ration card / BPL document / 14-point declaration for migrants
application_steps: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or visit nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas).
Submit filled Ujjwala application with KYC documents.
Distributor performs de-duplication check.
Receive connection, gas cylinder, and stove.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC/ST/OBC/EWS Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
summary: Financial support covering non-refundable college/university tuition fees and maintenance allowance for post-matriculation or post-secondary stage education.

eligibility.criteria: Students who have passed Class 10/Matriculation and are pursuing recognized post-matric courses. Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh per year.

benefits: Full reimbursement of non-refundable tuition fees directly to institute or student, plus monthly academic allowance/maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/year for hostellers.
documents_required: Income Certificate issued by competent authority (Tehsildar/SDM)
Fee receipt and college Bonafide Certificate
application_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR (One Time Registration).
Login using OTR number and fill applicant details.
Upload caste, income, and academic documents.
Application is verified online by institute and district nodal officer, funds disbursed via DBT.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / RBI
summary: Timely and adequate credit to farmers for agricultural needs, seeds, fertilizers, and post-harvest expenses at an effective subsidized interest rate of just 4% p.a. for loans up to ₹3 lakh.

eligibility.criteria: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and self-help groups of farmers. Also extended to fisheries and animal husbandry.

benefits: Credit limit up to ₹3 lakh without collateral up to ₹1.6 lakh. Nominal interest rate of 7%, reduced to 4% p.a. with prompt repayment incentive of 3%. Includes ATM-enabled RuPay debit card and personal accident cover.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, PAN or Voter ID
application_steps: Download simple 1-page KCC form from pmkisan.gov.in or bank portal.
Submit form with land documents at commercial bank, RRB, or cooperative bank branch.
Bank processes card within 14 days.
Receive RuPay KCC card for ATM withdrawals.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
summary: Maternity cash benefit of ₹5,000 for 1st living child and ₹6,000 for 2nd child (if girl) to compensate for wage loss and promote nutritional care.

eligibility.criteria: Pregnant women and lactating mothers who are not regular employees of Central/State Govt or PSUs. Family annual income less than ₹8 lakh.

benefits: ₹5,000 in two installments for 1st child upon antenatal checkup and child immunization. For 2nd child, if it is a girl child, a lump sum of ₹6,000 is given to discourage female foeticide.
documents_required: Income certificate or eligible beneficiary card (E-Shram, NFSA, etc.)
application_steps: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or health sub-centre within 570 days of LMP.
Or apply online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
Submit MCP card details after registration and medical checkup.
Benefit transferred directly to woman's bank account via DBT.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: Comprehensive crop insurance against non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, pests, unseasonal rain, hailstorm) with farmer premium capped at 1.5% - 2%.

eligibility.criteria: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.

benefits: Full sum insured payout for localized calamities, prevented sowing, post-harvest losses, and mid-season adversity. Farmers pay only 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops. Balance premium paid by government.
documents_required: Land Ownership papers / Rent agreement for tenant farmers
application_steps: Apply through PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in), nearest CSC, or bank.
Enter crop and field location details before cutoff date.
Pay nominal farmer premium.
Report crop damage within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App or toll-free number 14447 in case of localized calamity.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.

eligibility.criteria: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading. In non-individual enterprises, 51% stake must be held by SC/ST or woman.

benefits: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore covering up to 85% of project cost with lowest applicable interest rate for the category.
documents_required: Partnership deed or incorporation certificate (if applicable)
Lease or ownership documents for business premises
application_steps: Visit standupmitra.in portal and register as 'Borrower'.
Submit project details and choose handholding support if needed.
Select preferred bank branch.
Bank inspects project proposal and sanctions loan.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: Affordable life insurance providing ₹2,00,000 death benefit for any cause of death at a premium of just ₹436 per year (auto-debited).

eligibility.criteria: Any individual aged 18 to 50 having a savings bank account with consent to join auto-debit facility. Cover lasts up to age 55.

benefits: ₹2,00,000 paid to nominee on death of subscriber due to any cause. Premium is only ₹436/year (~₹1.20 per day).
documents_required: Savings Bank Account with auto-debit consent
application_steps: Log into Internet Banking / Mobile App of your bank.
Navigate to Government Schemes / Insurance / PMJJBY.
Confirm nominee and agree to auto-debit ₹436/year.
Or fill simple enrollment slip at your local bank branch.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: Most affordable accident insurance offering ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent total disability at a tiny premium of just ₹20 per year.

eligibility.criteria: Any individual aged 18 to 70 having a savings bank account with consent to join auto-debit.

benefits: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent total disability (loss of both eyes/limbs). ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability. Annual premium is only ₹20.
documents_required: Savings Bank Account with auto-debit consent
application_steps: Enroll via NetBanking / Mobile Banking app under Insurance section.
Or visit your bank branch and submit PMSBY consent form.
₹20 is auto-debited annually before May 31st.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
summary: Free industry-relevant skill training and certification in emerging fields (AI, robotics, IoT, drones, green energy) with placement assistance and stipend.

eligibility.criteria: Unemployed youth or school/college dropouts looking for employment skills.

benefits: 100% free short-term skill training, government recognized skill certificate, assessment, post-placement stipend, and direct job fairs.
application_steps: Visit skillindia.gov.in or pmkvyofficial.org.
Register as a candidate and browse training courses in your district.
Enroll in an approved Skill India training centre.
Complete course, clear assessment test, and receive certificate and placement assistance.

name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / KVIC
summary: Credit-linked subsidy scheme offering up to 35% government subsidy on project cost up to ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for service enterprises.

eligibility.criteria: Any individual above 18 years. For projects above ₹10 lakh in manufacturing and ₹5 lakh in service, minimum educational qualification is 8th pass.

benefits: Subsidy rate: General category gets 15% (urban) and 25% (rural). Special categories (SC, ST, OBC, Minorities, Women, Ex-servicemen, Differently-abled) get 25% (urban) and 35% (rural) of the project cost.
documents_required: Caste / Special category certificate (if claiming higher subsidy)
8th standard pass certificate or higher marksheet
Rural area certificate (from Sarpanch/Panchayat if applying in rural)
application_steps: Apply online on kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal.
Fill online application with project cost and upload documents.
Agency (KVIC/KVIB/DIC) verifies application and forwards to selected financing bank.
Undergo mandatory EDP training online or offline before loan disbursement.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission - Individual Household Latrine (IHHL)
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti / Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Rural and Urban households without toilets
summary: Direct financial assistance of ₹12,000 for construction of a hygienic household toilet.

eligibility.criteria: Households that do not currently have access to an individual sanitary toilet.

benefits: ₹12,00,000 cash incentive credited directly to the beneficiary's bank account in stages upon geo-tagging the toilet construction.
documents_required: Photograph of applicant in front of the proposed/constructed toilet
application_steps: Apply online on sbm.gov.in (Gramin) or swachhbharaturban.gov.in (Urban).
Submit Aadhaar, bank details, and address.
Field officer verifies location and gives approval.
Construct toilet, upload geo-tagged photo, and receive ₹12,000 DBT.

name: Lakhpati Didi Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
summary: National initiative to empower 3 crore rural women in SHGs to earn a sustainable income of at least ₹1 lakh per year through skill training, micro-enterprises, and market linkage.

eligibility.criteria: Women members of active Day-NRLM Self-Help Groups (SHGs) in rural areas committed to taking up enterprise or value-addition activities.

benefits: Training in financial literacy, digital tools, drone piloting (Namo Drone Didi), livestock, organic farming, tailoring, and food processing; interest-free or concessional credit through Community Investment Fund and bank linkage; direct access to government GeM portal for selling products.
application_steps: Join or contact your village Self-Help Group (SHG) under NRLM.
Attend Village Organization (VO) / Cluster Level Federation (CLF) Lakhpati Didi planning meetings.
Submit your micro-investment plan (MIP) for chosen enterprise.
Receive skill training and credit disbursement.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: Universal access to banking with zero balance savings accounts, free RuPay debit card with ₹2 lakh accident cover, and overdraft facility up to ₹10,000.

eligibility.criteria: Any Indian citizen without a basic bank account.

benefits: No minimum balance requirement. Free RuPay debit card with ₹2 lakh built-in accident insurance. Access to DBT government subsidies. Overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 for women account holders after 6 months of satisfactory operation.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card (single document suffices for KYC and address)
application_steps: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra / CSP kiosk.
Fill simple PMJDY account opening form.
Provide Aadhaar card for biometric verification.
Get passbook and instant RuPay debit card.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
summary: Voluntary contributory pension scheme ensuring guaranteed minimum pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60, with equal 50:50 contribution by Central Government.

eligibility.criteria: Unorganized workers with monthly income up to ₹15,000. Not covered under EPFO, ESIC, or NPS, and not an income tax payer.

benefits: Guaranteed ₹3,000 per month pension after 60. Monthly contribution between ₹55 and ₹200 (matched 100% by Central Govt). Family pension of 50% to spouse on subscriber death.
documents_required: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC
application_steps: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or apply on maandhan.in.
CSC operator enters Aadhaar and bank details for e-KYC.
System calculates monthly contribution based on entry age.
Pay 1st contribution in cash; auto-debit set up for future. Instant Shram Yogi Pension Card issued.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
summary: Provides on-the-job industrial apprenticeship training with direct government stipend support of up to ₹1,500/month (25% of total stipend).

eligibility.criteria: Candidates with minimum 5th to 12th pass, ITI, Diploma, or Degree seeking practical industrial training.

benefits: Practical hands-on industry experience in top private and public firms; monthly stipend (₹5,000 - ₹12,000) with ₹1,500 directly paid by Central Govt into candidate bank account; National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC).
application_steps: Register as 'Candidate' on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
Complete e-KYC with Aadhaar.
Search and apply for open apprenticeship opportunities by trade/location.
Attend interview, sign apprenticeship contract, and join training.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers / Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India
summary: Provides high-quality generic medicines, surgical items, and sanitary pads at 50% to 90% cheaper prices compared to branded medicines through Janaushadhi Kendras.

eligibility.criteria: Open to all Indian citizens without any income or category restriction. Anyone can purchase medicines with a valid doctor prescription.

benefits: Over 2,000 generic medicines and 300 surgical items available at 50% to 90% discount. Suvidha oxo-biodegradable sanitary napkins at just ₹1 per pad. Substantial monthly healthcare savings for chronic diabetes, hypertension, and cardiac patients.
application_steps: Download 'Janaushadhi Sugam' mobile app or visit janaushadhi.gov.in.
Search for nearest Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendra (over 10,000 centres nationwide).
Show prescription and purchase generic medicines at deeply discounted rates.
